title: Spanish Turnip Stir Fry
description: A simple and delicious stir fry recipe that combines the flavors of Spain with the sweetness of turnips.
instructions: Heat the light olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced turnips and cook for 5 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the chopped onion and cook for another 2-3 minutes, or until the onion is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Stir in the cooked turnips and onion mixture.
Use a spatula to break up any clumps and distribute the turnips evenly.
Continue cooking for another 2-3 minutes, or until the turnips are tender and lightly browned.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Garnish with chopped cilantro if desired.
